title: YaStaffMode
description: YaStaffMode is a free plugin that allows staff to use the command /staffmode. Upon sending this command, the staff gets put into "staffmode" where the staff is automatically vanished and sends a leave message in chat. Then it has fully configurable items.
body:
YaStaffMode is a fully configurable plugin that allows server staff to get access to items which use commands on players and themselves. Below are the items and commands explained.

Ice: freezes the player that the staff is looking at. Right click to toggle.
Paper: Shows the history of a player upon right clicking the player. 
Diamond: Toggles /vanish. 
Emerald: Randomly Teleports to a player upon right clicking.
Chest: Issues the command /punish to the player the staff is looking at. Right click to use.

All items are fully configurable and commands can be changed. Deluxe Menus is needed to add a punishment GUI for /punish or you can download a Punishment GUI plugin. Litebans is needed for /history. When in staffmode, staff cannot take things out of GMC. When opening chests in staffmode, the animation is removed and the GUI is the only thing that shows. This applies to all container related items. EssentialsX is needed for vanish. Any other plugins also work if vanish is included. The command for it must be /v or /vanish.

DM @yankeeh on discord if any issues occur! User ID: 1223478873442750595
